releaseNotes:
1. Canonical Single ThermalReceiptTicket Component: Shared 100% across Admin Hub Live Preview, POS Register Checkout, Duplicate Receipt reprint, and Self-Service Customer Kiosk with token banner.
2. Outlet Profile Data Persistence: Fixed server-side partial update wipe bug and synchronized PostgreSQL/SQLite tax registrations (GSTIN, PAN, FSSAI) and branch name on prints.
3. Currency & Alignment Fix: Cleaned currency symbols and spacing to eliminate double-dot artifacts ('Rs..') and adjusted ITEM, QTY, RATE, AMT column widths for 80mm continuous thermal rolls.
